transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I keep feeling dizzy when I stand up.

Can you tell me when you first started feeling dizzy when you stand up, whether it came on suddenly or gradually and what was happening at the time, and also if you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
About ten days ago, I think.
Could you describe how bad the dizziness is and how much it affects your day-to-day life, and also tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have started or changed recently?
About six out of ten; I nearly fell once.
Could you tell me a bit about your health in the past, like any ongoing conditions, past illnesses, operations, or times you were in hospital?
I've had high blood pressure for about fifteen years.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to any medicines, or are you not sure?
No, no allergies to medicines.
When you feel dizzy standing up, do you notice anything else happening at the same time?
No chest pain or palpitations, nothing like that.
What medicines do you take regularly, and have you started or changed any of them recently — and if you know, what doses do you take?
Started a new blood-pressure tablet a couple of weeks ago.
When you feel dizzy standing up, where do you notice that feeling, and does it spread anywhere?
It's a swimmy, about-to-faint feeling, not the room spinning.
Besides your high blood pressure, is there anything else you see a doctor or nurse about regularly?
I've got arthritis in both hips.
When that swimmy, about-to-faint feeling comes on, where do you feel it — for example in your head, in your chest or belly, or does it spread to other places?
Just in my head, really. My daughter worries about me living alone.
What would you most like us to talk about at this visit?
I'm worried the new tablet's causing it — should I stop it?
Besides your high blood pressure and arthritis, is there anything else you take medicines for, including anything that led to the new blood-pressure tablet you started a couple of weeks ago?
The practice nurse added it for high readings.
Since the dizzy feeling when you stand up started, has it changed how independently you manage things at home?
I've stopped going to my Tuesday lunch club.
Have you ever had any operations or hospital stays that we haven’t talked about yet?
No, nothing I can think of.
When you get that dizzy feeling, how long does it usually last?
Less than a minute, usually.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
